question_text: All Cottage and Apartment objects call Accommodation.__init__ once. Outline how one shared counter can track their combined number.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Initialize Accommodation.count=0 at class level and increment Accommodation.count in the shared initializer. Reading Accommodation.count retrieves the combined count without using an instance-specific counter.

marking_points.criterion: Increment that class counter once for each object.
